snapshot_date: Fixed release observation date, not product launch date.
observed_at: Collection fetch timestamp in Hong Kong time (+08:00).
selection_position: Position in the first 30 records returned by the public collection endpoint; order is not a rank of demand.
product_id: Public Shopify product/listing identifier; not a manufacturer part number or a physical-item ID.
listing_title: Exact supplier title captured in the collection and checked against the public product-page H1.
title_family_label: Lexical title grouping. First matching token among Goggles, Matrice, Mavic, Inspire, Mini, Air; otherwise Other title family. Not compatibility.
source_condition_phrase: OEM-pulled only when that exact phrase appears in the title; empty means not observed. Supplier assertion, not independent authentication.
source_published_at: Publication timestamp provided by the supplier collection source; not proof of manufacture, first sale or model release.
source_kind: All rows are supplier_published_listing, explicitly first-party evidence.
independent_compatibility_test: not_performed throughout; no cross-model interchangeability, engineering fit, installation or flight-safety test has been established.
